51	public struct DockHostIdentityResolver: Equatable, Sendable {
52	    private struct HostRecord: Equatable, Sendable {
53	        var host: DockHostConfiguration
54	        var aliases: Set<String>
55	        var displayNames: [String]
56	        var endpoints: [String]
57	        var hasObservedLogicalIdentity: Bool
58	    }
59	
60	    private struct LogicalRecord: Equatable, Sendable {
61	        var logicalHostID: String
62	        var records: [HostRecord]
63	        var hasObservedLogicalIdentity: Bool
64	    }
65	
66	    public static let empty = DockHostIdentityResolver(hosts: [])
67	
68	    private let logicalRecordsByID: [String: LogicalRecord]
69	    private let logicalIDsByAlias: [String: Set<String>]
70	    private let logicalIDByConfiguredHostID: [String: String]
71	    private let hostStatuses: [String: DockHostLoadStatus]
72	
73	    public init(
74	        hosts: [DockHostConfiguration],
75	        observations: [DockHostIdentityObservation] = [],
76	        hostStatuses: [String: DockHostLoadStatus] = [:]
77	    ) {
78	        let observationsByConfiguredHostID = Dictionary(grouping: observations, by: \.configuredHostID)
79	        self.hostStatuses = hostStatuses
80	
81	        var logicalRecordsByID: [String: LogicalRecord] = [:]
82	        var logicalIDByConfiguredHostID: [String: String] = [:]
83	
84	        for host in hosts {
85	            let hostObservations = observationsByConfiguredHostID[host.id] ?? []
86	            let observedLogicalHostID = Self.firstNonEmpty(
87	                hostObservations.map(\.logicalHostID) + hostObservations.map(\.streamHostID)
88	            )
89	            let logicalHostID = observedLogicalHostID ?? host.id
90	            logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[host.id] = logicalHostID
91	
92	            var aliases = Set<String>()
93	            [
94	                host.id,
95	                host.displayName,
96	                host.endpoint.displayEndpoint,
97	                logicalHostID
98	            ].forEach { Self.insertAlias($0, into: &aliases) }
99	            for observation in hostObservations {
100	                [
101	                    observation.configuredHostID,
102	                    observation.streamHostID,
103	                    observation.logicalHostID,
104	                    observation.displayName,
105	                    observation.endpoint
106	                ].forEach { Self.insertAlias($0, into: &aliases) }
107	            }
108	
109	            let displayNames = Self.uniqueNonEmpty(
110	                hostObservations.map(\.displayName) + [host.displayName, logicalHostID]
111	            )
112	            let endpoints = Self.uniqueNonEmpty(
113	                hostObservations.map(\.endpoint) + [host.endpoint.displayEndpoint]
114	            )
115	            let record = HostRecord(
116	                host: host,
117	                aliases: aliases,
118	                displayNames: displayNames,
119	                endpoints: endpoints,
120	                hasObservedLogicalIdentity: observedLogicalHostID != nil
121	            )
122	
123	            var logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID]
124	                ?? LogicalRecord(
125	                    logicalHostID: logicalHostID,
126	                    records: [],
127	                    hasObservedLogicalIdentity: false
128	                )
129	            logicalRecord.records.append(record)
130	            logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity = logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity || record.hasObservedLogicalIdentity
131	            logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID] = logicalRecord
132	        }
133	
134	        var logicalIDsByAlias: [String: Set<String>] = [:]
135	        for logicalRecord in logicalRecordsByID.values {
136	            for record in logicalRecord.records {
137	                for alias in record.aliases {
138	                    logicalIDsByAlias[alias, default: []].insert(logicalRecord.logicalHostID)
139	                    logicalIDsByAlias[Self.normalizedAlias(alias), default: []].insert(logicalRecord.logicalHostID)
140	                }
141	            }
142	        }
143	
144	        self.logicalRecordsByID = logicalRecordsByID
145	        self.logicalIDByConfiguredHostID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID
146	        self.logicalIDsByAlias = logicalIDsByAlias
147	    }
148	
149	    public func logicalHostID(
150	        forAlias alias: String,
151	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
152	    ) -> String? {
153	        let aliasLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: alias)
154	        if let sourceConfiguredHostID,
155	           let sourceLogicalID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[sourceConfiguredHostID],
156	           aliasLogicalIDs.isEmpty || aliasLogicalIDs.contains(sourceLogicalID) {
157	            return sourceLogicalID
158	        }
159	        guard aliasLogicalIDs.count == 1 else {
160	            return nil
161	        }
162	        return aliasLogicalIDs.first
163	    }
164	
165	    public func migrationLogicalHostID(
166	        forAlias alias: String,
167	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
168	    ) -> String? {
169	        guard let logicalHostID = logicalHostID(
170	            forAlias: alias,
171	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
172	        ),
173	              let logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID],
174	              logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity else {
175	            return nil
176	        }
177	        return logicalHostID
178	    }

180	    public func resolve(
181	        rowHostID: String,
182	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
183	        preferredConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
184	    ) -> ResolvedDockHost? {
185	        let logicalHostID = logicalHostID(
186	            forAlias: rowHostID,
187	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
188	        )
189	        guard let logicalHostID,
190	              let logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID] else {
191	            return nil
192	        }
193	
194	        guard let selectedRecord = preferredRecord(
195	            in: logicalRecord,
196	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID,
197	            preferredConfiguredHostID: preferredConfiguredHostID
198	        ) else {
199	            return nil
200	        }
201	
202	        return ResolvedDockHost(
203	            logicalHostID: logicalHostID,
204	            host: selectedRecord.host,
205	            configuredHostIDs: logicalRecord.records.map(\.host.id),
206	            displayName: selectedRecord.displayNames.first ?? selectedRecord.host.displayName,
207	            endpoint: selectedRecord.endpoints.first ?? selectedRecord.host.endpoint.displayEndpoint
208	        )
209	    }
210	
211	    public func contains(
212	        rowHostID: String,
213	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
214	        in configuredHostID: String
215	    ) -> Bool {
216	        guard let expectedLogicalID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[configuredHostID] else {
217	            return false
218	        }
219	        let rowLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: rowHostID)
220	        guard rowLogicalIDs.count == 1,
221	              rowLogicalIDs.contains(expectedLogicalID) else {
222	            return false
223	        }
224	        guard let sourceConfiguredHostID else {
225	            return true
226	        }
227	        let sourceLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: sourceConfiguredHostID)
228	        if sourceLogicalIDs.isEmpty,
229	           sourceConfiguredHostID == configuredHostID {
230	            return true
231	        }
232	        return sourceLogicalIDs.count == 1 && sourceLogicalIDs.contains(expectedLogicalID)
233	    }
234	
235	    public func displayName(
236	        forAlias alias: String,
237	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
238	    ) -> String? {
239	        resolve(
240	            rowHostID: alias,
241	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
242	        )?.displayName
243	    }
244	
245	    public func endpoint(
246	        forAlias alias: String,
247	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
248	    ) -> String? {
249	        resolve(
250	            rowHostID: alias,
251	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
252	        )?.endpoint
253	    }
254	
255	    public func state(
256	        forAlias alias: String,
257	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
258	        in states: [DockHostStateViewModel]
259	    ) -> DockHostStateViewModel? {
260	        guard let resolved = resolve(
261	            rowHostID: alias,
262	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
263	        ) else {
264	            return nil
265	        }
266	        return states.first { resolved.configuredHostIDs.contains($0.host.id) }
267	    }
268	
269	    private func logicalIDs(forAlias alias: String) -> Set<String> {
270	        let trimmed = alias.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
271	        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else {
272	            return []
273	        }
274	        return logicalIDsByAlias[trimmed]
275	            ?? logicalIDsByAlias[Self.normalizedAlias(trimmed)]
276	            ?? []
277	    }
278	
279	    private func preferredRecord(
280	        in logicalRecord: LogicalRecord,
281	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String?,
282	        preferredConfiguredHostID: String?
283	    ) -> HostRecord? {
284	        if let sourceConfiguredHostID,
285	           let record = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { $0.host.id == sourceConfiguredHostID }) {
286	            return record
287	        }
288	        if let preferredConfiguredHostID,
289	           let record = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { $0.host.id == preferredConfiguredHostID }) {
290	            return record
291	        }
292	        if let loadedRecord = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { isLoadedStatus(hostStatuses[$0.host.id]) }) {
293	            return loadedRecord
294	        }
295	        return logicalRecord.records.first
296	    }
297	
298	    private func isLoadedStatus(_ status: DockHostLoadStatus?) -> Bool {
299	        guard let status else {
300	            return false
301	        }
302	        switch status {
303	        case .loaded, .degraded, .empty:
304	            return true
305	        case .checking, .offline, .error:
306	            return false
307	        }
308	    }
309	
310	    private static func insertAlias(_ value: String?, into aliases: inout Set<String>) {
311	        guard let value = nonEmpty(value) else {
312	            return
313	        }
314	        aliases.insert(value)
315	    }
316	
317	    private static func uniqueNonEmpty(_ values: [String?]) -> [String] {
318	        var seen: Set<String> = []
319	        var result: [String] = []
320	        for value in values {
321	            guard let value = nonEmpty(value),
322	                  seen.insert(value).inserted else {
323	                continue
324	            }
325	            result.append(value)
326	        }
327	        return result
328	    }
329	
330	    private static func firstNonEmpty(_ values: [String?]) -> String? {
331	        values.lazy.compactMap(nonEmpty).first
332	    }
333	
334	    private static func nonEmpty(_ value: String?) -> String? {
335	        let trimmed = value?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
336	        guard let trimmed, !trimmed.isEmpty else {
337	            return nil
338	        }
339	        return trimmed
340	    }
341	
342	    private static func normalizedAlias(_ value: String) -> String {
343	        value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
344	    }
345	}

406	    public func reportLifecycle(_ snapshot: AppLifecycleSnapshot) {
407	        switch snapshot.phase {
408	        case .backgrounded:
409	            markAllHosts(.backgrounded("Backgrounded"))
410	        case .foregroundResuming:
411	            markAllHosts(.resuming("Resuming"))
412	        case .active:
413	            clearLifecyclePhase()
414	        case .inactive:
415	            return
416	        }
417	    }

419	    private func record(hostStates: [DockHostStateViewModel], source: ObservationSource) {
420	        for hostState in hostStates {
421	            let phase: HostConnectivityPhase
422	            switch hostState.status {
423	            case .checking:
424	                phase = .checking
425	            case .loaded(let rowCount, _):
426	                phase = .online("\(rowCount) sessions")
427	            case .degraded(_, let message):
428	                phase = .partial(message)
429	            case .empty:
430	                phase = .online("Online, no sessions")
431	            case .offline(let message):
432	                phase = .offline(message)
433	            case .error(let message):
434	                phase = .error(message)
435	            }
436	            record(host: hostState.host, source: source, phase: phase)
437	        }
438	    }

440	    private func markAllHosts(_ phase: HostConnectivityPhase) {
441	        guard !records.isEmpty else {
442	            overallStatus = rollup([])
443	            return
444	        }
445	        for id in Array(records.keys) {
446	            records[id]?.lifecyclePhase = phase
447	        }
448	        publish()
449	    }
450	
451	    private func clearLifecyclePhase() {
452	        guard !records.isEmpty else {
453	            publishBootstrapStatusIfNeeded()
454	            return
455	        }
456	        for id in Array(records.keys) {
457	            records[id]?.lifecyclePhase = nil
458	        }
459	        publish()
460	    }

462	    private func record(
463	        host: DockHostViewModel,
464	        source: ObservationSource,
465	        phase: HostConnectivityPhase,
466	        checked: Bool = true,
467	        checkedAt: Date? = nil,
468	        successAt: Date? = nil
469	    ) {
470	        bootstrapStatus = nil
471	        let timestamp = checkedAt ?? (checked ? now() : nil)
472	        var record = records[host.id] ?? HostRecord(
473	            id: host.id,
474	            displayName: host.displayName,
475	            endpoint: host.endpoint,
476	            observations: [:],
477	            routeDiagnostics: [:],
478	            lifecyclePhase: nil
479	        )
480	        if !hostOrder.contains(host.id) {
481	            hostOrder.append(host.id)
482	        }
483	        let existingObservation = record.observations[source]
484	        let lastSuccessAt: Date?
485	        if let successAt {
486	            lastSuccessAt = successAt
487	        } else if phase.isOnlineLike {
488	            lastSuccessAt = timestamp ?? now()
489	        } else {
490	            lastSuccessAt = existingObservation?.lastSuccessAt
491	        }
492	
493	        record.observations[source] = Observation(
494	            phase: phase,
495	            lastCheckedAt: timestamp ?? existingObservation?.lastCheckedAt,
496	            lastSuccessAt: lastSuccessAt
497	        )
498	        records[host.id] = record
499	        publish()
500	    }
501	
502	    private func publishBootstrapStatusIfNeeded() {
503	        guard records.isEmpty else {
504	            publish()
505	            return
506	        }
507	        hosts = []
508	        overallStatus = bootstrapStatus ?? .unconfigured("No relay host configured.")
509	        logOverallStatusIfNeeded(overallStatus)
510	    }
511	
512	    private func publish() {
513	        let nextHosts = records.values
514	            .map(snapshot(from:))
515	            .sorted { lhs, rhs in
516	                let leftIndex = hostIndex(lhs.id)
517	                let rightIndex = hostIndex(rhs.id)
518	                if leftIndex == rightIndex {
519	                    return lhs.displayName < rhs.displayName
520	                }
521	                return leftIndex < rightIndex
522	            }
523	        let nextOverallStatus = rollup(nextHosts)
524	        hosts = nextHosts
525	        overallStatus = nextOverallStatus
526	        logHostPhasesIfNeeded(nextHosts)
527	        logOverallStatusIfNeeded(nextOverallStatus)
528	    }

530	    private func snapshot(from record: HostRecord) -> HostConnectivitySnapshot {
531	        let observations = Array(record.observations.values)
532	        let routeDiagnostics = record.routeDiagnostics.values.sorted { $0.route < $1.route }
533	        let routePhase = phaseForRouteDiagnostics(routeDiagnostics)
534	        let observationPhase = rollupObservations(observations)
535	        return HostConnectivitySnapshot(
536	            id: record.id,
537	            displayName: record.displayName,
538	            endpoint: record.endpoint,
539	            phase: record.lifecyclePhase ?? routePhase ?? observationPhase,
540	            lastCheckedAt: latestDate(observations.compactMap(\.lastCheckedAt)),
541	            lastSuccessAt: latestDate(observations.compactMap(\.lastSuccessAt)),
542	            routeDiagnostics: routeDiagnostics
543	        )
544	    }
545	
546	    private func phaseForRouteDiagnostics(_ diagnostics: [RouteDiagnosticSnapshot]) -> HostConnectivityPhase? {
547	        guard let failed = diagnostics.first(where: { $0.appCritical && $0.routeStatus == .failed }) else {
548	            return nil
549	        }
550	        return .partial("\(failed.route) failed")
551	    }
552	
553	    private func rollupObservations(_ observations: [Observation]) -> HostConnectivityPhase {
554	        guard let strongest = observations.min(by: {
555	            priority(for: $0.phase) < priority(for: $1.phase)
556	        }) else {
557	            return .unknown
558	        }
559	        return strongest.phase
560	    }
561	
562	    private func rollup(_ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot]) -> AppConnectivityOverallStatus {
563	        guard !hosts.isEmpty else {
564	            return bootstrapStatus ?? .unconfigured("No relay host configured.")
565	        }
566	
567	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
568	            if case .configurationError = $0.phase { return true }
569	            return false
570	        }) {
571	            return .configurationError(status.phase.message)
572	        }
573	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
574	            if case .backgrounded = $0.phase { return true }
575	            return false
576	        }) {
577	            return .backgrounded("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
578	        }
579	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
580	            if case .resuming = $0.phase { return true }
581	            return false
582	        }) {
583	            return .resuming("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
584	        }
585	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
586	            if case .reconnecting = $0.phase { return true }
587	            return false
588	        }) {
589	            return .reconnecting("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
590	        }
591	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
592	            if case .stale = $0.phase { return true }
593	            return false
594	        }) {
595	            return .stale("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
596	        }
597	        let onlineLikeCount = hosts.filter { $0.phase.isOnlineLike }.count
598	        let checkingCount = hosts.filter { status in
599	            if case .checking = status.phase {
600	                return true
601	            }
602	            return false
603	        }.count
604	        if checkingCount == hosts.count {
605	            return .checking(hosts.count == 1 ? hosts[0].phase.message : "Checking \(hosts.count) hosts")
606	        }
607	        if onlineLikeCount > 0, checkingCount > 0 {
608	            return .partial("Online \(onlineLikeCount)/\(hosts.count), checking \(checkingCount)")
609	        }
610	        if onlineLikeCount == hosts.count {
611	            if let partial = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
612	                if case .partial = $0.phase { return true }
613	                return false
614	            }) {
615	                return .partial("\(partial.displayName): \(partial.phase.message)")
616	            }
617	            return .online(hosts.count == 1 ? hosts[0].phase.message : "\(hosts.count) hosts online")
618	        }
619	        if onlineLikeCount > 0 {
620	            let failing = hosts.first { !$0.phase.isOnlineLike } ?? hosts[0]
621	            return .partial("\(failing.displayName): \(failing.phase.message)")
622	        }
623	
624	        if let error = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
625	            if case .error = $0.phase { return true }
626	            return false
627	        }) {
628	            return .error("\(error.displayName): \(error.phase.message)")
629	        }
630	        if let offline = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
631	            if case .offline = $0.phase { return true }
632	            return false
633	        }) {
634	            return .offline("\(offline.displayName): \(offline.phase.message)")
635	        }
636	
637	        return .checking("Waiting for first check")
638	    }
639	
640	    private func priority(for phase: HostConnectivityPhase) -> Int {
641	        switch phase {
642	        case .configurationError:
643	            return 0
644	        case .backgrounded:
645	            return 1
646	        case .resuming:
647	            return 2
648	        case .reconnecting:
649	            return 3
650	        case .stale:
651	            return 4
652	        case .checking:
653	            return 5
654	        case .offline:
655	            return 6
656	        case .error:
657	            return 7
658	        case .partial:
659	            return 8
660	        case .online:
661	            return 9
662	        case .unknown:
663	            return 10
664	        }
665	    }
666	
667	    private func firstStatus(
668	        _ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot],
669	        matching predicate: (HostConnectivitySnapshot) -> Bool
670	    ) -> HostConnectivitySnapshot? {
671	        hosts.first(where: predicate)
672	    }
673	
674	    private func latestDate(_ dates: [Date]) -> Date? {
675	        dates.max()
676	    }
677	
678	    private func hostIndex(_ hostID: String) -> Int {
679	        hostOrder.firstIndex(of: hostID) ?? Int.max
680	    }
681	
682	    private func logHostPhasesIfNeeded(_ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot]) {
683	        for host in hosts {
684	            guard lastLoggedHostPhases[host.id] != host.phase else {
685	                continue
686	            }
687	            lastLoggedHostPhases[host.id] = host.phase
688	            DockLog.connectivity.info("connectivity host phase host_id=\(host.id, privacy: .public) endpoint=\(host.endpoint, privacy: .public) phase=\(host.phase.logDescription, privacy: .public) message=\(DockLog.redacted(host.phase.message), privacy: .public)")

690	    }

695	        }

697	        DockLog.connectivity.notice("connectivity overall status=\(status.label, privacy: .public) message=\(DockLog.redacted(status.message), privacy: .public)")
698	    }
699	}

718	        case .stale:
719	            return "stale"
720	        case .offline:
721	            return "offline"

182	    public func includes(_ event: ThreadEvent) -> Bool {
183	        switch self {
184	        case .messages:
185	            return ThreadMessageSemantics.isDefaultVisibleMessage(event)
186	        case .all:
187	            return true
188	        case .kind(let kind):
189	            return event.kind == kind
190	        }
191	    }

193	    public func visibleEvents(from events: [ThreadEvent]) -> [ThreadEvent] {
194	        ThreadEventDisplayOrder.newestFirst(events.filter { includes($0) })
195	    }
196	}

198	public enum ThreadMessageSemantics {
199	    public static func isDefaultVisibleMessage(_ event: ThreadEvent) -> Bool {
200	        event.request != nil
201	            || event.visibilityCategory == .request
202	            || (
203	                event.visibilityCategory == .message
204	                    && (event.kind == .userMessage || event.kind == .agentMessage)
205	            )
206	    }
207	
208	    public static func latestMessage(in events: [ThreadEvent]) -> ThreadEvent? {
209	        ThreadEventDisplayOrder.newestFirst(events.filter(isDefaultVisibleMessage)).first
210	    }
211	
212	    public static func activityDate(for event: ThreadEvent) -> Date? {
213	        event.activityDate ?? event.displayGroupDate ?? event.date
214	    }
215	}
216	
217	public enum ThreadEventDisplayOrder {
218	    public static func newestFirst(_ events: [ThreadEvent]) -> [ThreadEvent] {
219	        let indexed = events.enumerated().map { offset, event in
220	            IndexedEvent(offset: offset, event: event)
221	        }
222	
223	        return indexed.sorted(by: areInNewestFirstOrder).map(\.event)
224	    }
225	
226	    static func shouldPrecedeInNewestFirstOrder(_ left: ThreadEvent, _ right: ThreadEvent) -> Bool {
227	        areInNewestFirstOrder(
228	            IndexedEvent(offset: 0, event: left),
229	            IndexedEvent(offset: 1, event: right)
230	        )
231	    }
232	
233	    private static func areInNewestFirstOrder(_ left: IndexedEvent, _ right: IndexedEvent) -> Bool {
234	        let leftKey = left.event.displayOrderKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
235	        let rightKey = right.event.displayOrderKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
236	        if leftKey != rightKey {
237	            if leftKey.isEmpty {
238	                return false
239	            }
240	            if rightKey.isEmpty {
241	                return true
242	            }
243	            return leftKey < rightKey
244	        }
245	
246	        // Thread Detail rows are projection rows. Visible order is the relay
247	        // displayOrderKey, then projectionID. Do not recover order locally
248	        // from timestamps, turn order, item order, or row order.
249	        if left.event.id != right.event.id {
250	            return left.event.id < right.event.id
251	        }
252	
253	        return left.offset < right.offset
254	    }
255	
256	    private struct IndexedEvent {
257	        let offset: Int
258	        let event: ThreadEvent
259	    }
260	}

278	        guard case .string(let value) = self else {

282	    }
283	
284	    var numberValue: Double? {
285	        switch self {
286	        case .integer(let value):
287	            return Double(value)
288	        case .double(let value):
289	            return value
290	        case .null, .bool, .string, .array, .object:
291	            return nil
292	        }

212	        case (.commandApproval, .decline):

252	             (.userInput, .accept),

265	        var result: [String: JSONValue] = [:]
266	        if let network = permissions["network"], network != .null {

268	        }

270	            result["fileSystem"] = fileSystem
271	        }

327	        switch value {
328	        case .string(let text):
329	            return nonEmpty(text)
330	        case .array(let parts):
331	            return nonEmpty(parts.compactMap(\.stringValue).joined(separator: " "))
332	        case .object(let object):

334	                object["command"]?.stringValue,
335	                object["cmd"]?.stringValue,
336	                object["text"]?.stringValue
337	            )
338	        case .null, .bool, .integer, .double, nil:

348	            }
349	        }

356	        }

233	    public func load() async {
234	        guard !didLoad else {
235	            DockLog.threadDetail.debug("thread detail load skipped reason=already_loaded host_id=\(self.host.id, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
236	            return
237	        }
238	        didLoad = true
239	
240	        guard hostIdentityResolver.contains(
241	            rowHostID: row.hostID,
242	            sourceConfiguredHostID: row.sourceHostID,
243	            in: host.id
244	        ) else {
245	            DockLog.threadDetail.error("thread detail load failed reason=host_mismatch expected=\(self.host.id, privacy: .public) actual=\(self.row.hostID, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
246	            let message = "This row belongs to host \(self.row.hostID), not \(self.host.id)."
247	            state = .error(
248	                header,
249	                message
250	            )
251	            screenStore.setError(header: header, message: message)
252	            return
253	        }
254	
255	        state = .loading(header)
256	        screenStore.setLoading(header)
257	        liveState = .connecting
258	        isClosing = false
259	        let startedAt = Date()
260	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail load started host_id=\(self.host.id, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
261	
262	        let session = factory.makeSession(for: host, foregroundWorkGate: lifecycleCoordinator)
263	        self.session = session
264	
265	        do {
266	            _ = try await session.connectAndInitialize(
267	                params: .codexDock(version: "0.1.0"),
268	                timeout: CodexDockConstants.AppServer.connectInitializeTimeout
269	            )
270	            latestConnectionState = .connected
271	            liveEventBuffer.begin()
272	            startObservation(session: session)
273	
274	            let detailSnapshot = try await session.threadDetailSubscribe(
275	                params: ThreadDetailParams(threadId: row.threadID),
276	                timeout: CodexDockConstants.AppServer.defaultRequestTimeout
277	            )
278	            try await replaceEvents(from: detailSnapshot, liveState: .live)
279	            await replayBufferedLiveEvents()
280	            startDockRowRefreshIfNeeded()
281	            DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail load finished live host_id=\(self.host.id, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) events=\(self.events.count, privacy: .public) duration_ms=\(DockLog.milliseconds(since: startedAt), privacy: .public)")
282	        } catch {
283	            liveEventBuffer.discard()
284	            let message = message(from: error)
285	            state = .error(header, message)
286	            screenStore.setError(header: header, message: message)
287	            await session.disconnect()
288	            DockLog.threadDetail.error("thread detail load failed host_id=\(self.host.id, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) duration_ms=\(DockLog.milliseconds(since: startedAt), privacy: .public) error=\(DockLog.errorSummary(error), privacy: .public)")
289	        }
290	    }

292	    public func observeDockRowUpdate(_ updatedRow: DockRowViewModel) {
293	        guard updatedRow.id == row.id else {
294	            return
295	        }
296	
297	        row = updatedRow
298	        header = ThreadDetailHeader(host: host, row: updatedRow)
299	        latestDockRowActivityMarker = DockRowActivityMarker(row: updatedRow)
300	
301	        if case .loaded = state {
302	            publishLoaded()
303	        }
304	
305	        guard latestDockRowActivityMarker.isNewer(than: lastCompletedDockRowRefreshMarker) else {
306	            return
307	        }
308	
309	        // Dock activity can lead canonical turns by a moment. Re-read now, then
310	        // do one coalesced settled re-read through the same history path.
311	        scheduleDockRowSettleRefresh(for: latestDockRowActivityMarker)
312	        queueDockRowRefresh(for: latestDockRowActivityMarker)
313	    }

364	    public func sendDraft() async {
365	        guard let session else {
366	            composer.lastError = "Thread is not connected."
367	            DockLog.threadDetail.warning("send draft skipped reason=no_session thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
368	            return
369	        }
370	        guard !composer.voice.phase.isBusy else {
371	            composer.lastError = "Finish dictation before sending."
372	            DockLog.threadDetail.warning("send draft skipped reason=voice_busy thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
373	            return
374	        }
375	
376	        let text = composer.draft.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
377	        guard !text.isEmpty else {
378	            DockLog.threadDetail.debug("send draft skipped reason=empty thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
379	            return
380	        }
381	
382	        let startedAt = Date()
383	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("send draft started thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) characters=\(text.count, privacy: .public) active_turn=\((self.activeTurnID != nil), privacy: .public)")
384	        composer.isSending = true
385	        composer.lastError = nil
386	
387	        do {
388	            // Projection v1 does not create Swift-side optimistic rows. Visible
389	            // outbound rows must come from relay projection updates, otherwise
390	            // pending and canonical identities can split into duplicates.
391	            let nextTurnID = try await commandEngine.sendDraft(
392	                text,
393	                threadID: row.threadID,
394	                activeTurnID: activeTurnID,
395	                session: session
396	            )
397	            activeTurnID = nextTurnID ?? activeTurnID
398	            await dataEngine.setActiveTurnID(activeTurnID)
399	            composer.draft = ""
400	            composer.isSending = false
401	            DockLog.threadDetail.notice("send draft finished thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) duration_ms=\(DockLog.milliseconds(since: startedAt), privacy: .public) active_turn_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.activeTurnID), privacy: .public)")
402	        } catch {
403	            composer.isSending = false
404	            composer.lastError = message(from: error)
405	            DockLog.threadDetail.error("send draft failed thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) duration_ms=\(DockLog.milliseconds(since: startedAt), privacy: .public) error=\(DockLog.errorSummary(error), privacy: .public)")
406	        }
407	    }

452	        connectionTask?.cancel()
453	        notificationTask?.cancel()

455	        connectionTask = Task { [weak self] in
456	            for await state in session.connectionStates {
457	                self?.handle(connectionState: state)

459	        }

462	            for await notification in session.notifications {

476	        lifecycleTask?.cancel()

484	    private func handle(lifecycleSnapshot snapshot: AppLifecycleSnapshot) async {
485	        switch snapshot.phase {
486	        case .backgrounded:
487	            await handleAppBackgrounded()
488	        case .foregroundResuming:
489	            await handleForegroundResuming(snapshot)
490	        case .active, .inactive:
491	            return
492	        }
493	    }

495	    private func handleAppBackgrounded() async {
496	        guard !isClosing else {
497	            return
498	        }
499	
500	        recoveryTask?.cancel()
501	        recoveryTask = nil
502	
503	        if composer.voice.phase.isBusy {
504	            DockLog.voice.notice("voice capture stopping reason=backgrounded thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
505	            let activeTranscriptionSession = activeTranscriptionSession
506	            await cancelActiveVoiceCapture()
507	            failActiveDictation(message: "Dictation stopped because the app moved to the background.")
508	            await activeTranscriptionSession?.cancel()
509	        }
510	
511	        guard case .loaded = state, liveState != .closed else {
512	            return
513	        }
514	
515	        liveState = .stale("Backgrounded")
516	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail marked stale reason=backgrounded thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
517	        publishLoaded()
518	    }

520	    private func handleForegroundResuming(_ snapshot: AppLifecycleSnapshot) async {
521	        guard handledForegroundResumeGeneration != snapshot.resumeGeneration else {
522	            return
523	        }
524	        handledForegroundResumeGeneration = snapshot.resumeGeneration
525	
526	        guard !isClosing,
527	              case .loaded = state,
528	              liveState != .closed,
529	              let session else {
530	            return
531	        }
532	
533	        recoveryTask?.cancel()
534	        recoveryTask = nil
535	        if latestConnectionState == .connected {
536	            await rehydrateAfterReconnect(session: session, reason: "Resuming")
537	        } else if latestConnectionState.shouldWaitForForegroundRehydrate {
538	            markLiveSessionReconnecting("Resuming")
539	        } else {
540	            markLiveSessionStale(message(from: latestConnectionState))
541	        }
542	    }

544	    private func handle(connectionState: AppServerConnectionState) {
545	        latestConnectionState = connectionState
546	        DockLog.threadDetail.debug("thread detail connection state=\(connectionState.logDescription, privacy: .public) thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
547	        switch connectionState {
548	        case .reconnecting(_, let reason):
549	            markLiveSessionReconnecting(reason)
550	        case .connected:
551	            startRehydrateAfterReconnectIfNeeded()
552	        case .offline(let reason):
553	            markLiveSessionStale(reason)
554	        case .error(let message):
555	            markLiveSessionStale(message)
556	        case .closed(let reason):
557	            markLiveSessionStale(reason)
558	        case .idle, .connecting:
559	            return
560	        }
561	    }

563	    private func message(from connectionState: AppServerConnectionState) -> String {

565	        case .idle:
566	            return "Waiting for connection."
567	        case .connecting:
568	            return "Connecting."
569	        case .connected:
570	            return "Connected."
571	        case .reconnecting(_, let reason):
572	            return reason
573	        case .offline(let reason):
574	            return reason
575	        case .error(let message):
576	            return message
577	        case .closed(let reason):
578	            return reason
579	        }

583	        guard !isClosing,
584	              recoveryTask == nil,
585	              case .loaded = state,
586	              case let .reconnecting(reason) = liveState,
587	              let session else {
588	            return
589	        }

596	    private func rehydrateAfterReconnect(
597	        session: any ThreadDetailSession,
598	        reason: String
599	    ) async {
600	        guard !isClosing, case .loaded = state else {
601	            recoveryTask = nil
602	            return
603	        }
604	
605	        liveState = .reconnecting(reason)
606	        liveEventBuffer.begin()
607	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail rehydrate started thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) reason=\(DockLog.redacted(reason), privacy: .public)")
608	        publishLoaded()
609	
610	        do {
611	            let detailSnapshot = try await session.threadDetailResync(
612	                params: ThreadDetailParams(threadId: row.threadID),
613	                timeout: CodexDockConstants.AppServer.defaultRequestTimeout
614	            )
615	            try await replaceEvents(from: detailSnapshot, liveState: .live)
616	            await replayBufferedLiveEvents()
617	            DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail rehydrate finished thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) events=\(self.events.count, privacy: .public)")
618	        } catch {
619	            liveEventBuffer.discard()
620	            liveState = .stale(message(from: error))
621	            publishLoaded()
622	            DockLog.threadDetail.warning("thread detail rehydrate failed thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) error=\(DockLog.errorSummary(error), privacy: .public)")
623	        }
624	
625	        recoveryTask = nil
626	    }

628	    private func queueDockRowRefresh(for marker: DockRowActivityMarker, force: Bool = false) {
629	        if !force, !marker.isNewer(than: lastCompletedDockRowRefreshMarker) {
630	            return
631	        }
632	        if let pending = pendingDockRowRefreshMarker,
633	           pending.isNewer(than: marker) || pending == marker {
634	            return
635	        }
636	
637	        pendingDockRowRefreshMarker = marker
638	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail dock row advanced thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
639	        startDockRowRefreshIfNeeded()
640	    }

642	    private func scheduleDockRowSettleRefresh(for marker: DockRowActivityMarker) {
643	        dockRowSettleRefreshTask?.cancel()
644	        let delay = dockRowSettleRefreshDelay
645	        dockRowSettleRefreshTask = Task { [weak self] in
646	            do {
647	                try await Task.sleep(for: delay)
648	            } catch {
649	                return
650	            }
651	            self?.queueDockRowSettleRefreshIfCurrent(marker)
652	        }
653	    }

660	        queueDockRowRefresh(for: marker, force: true)
661	    }

665	              recoveryTask == nil,

679	    private func rehydrateAfterDockRowAdvance(
680	        session: any ThreadDetailSession,
681	        marker: DockRowActivityMarker
682	    ) async {
683	        guard !isClosing, case .loaded = state else {
684	            recoveryTask = nil
685	            return
686	        }
687	
688	        liveEventBuffer.begin()
689	        DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail dock row refresh started thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public)")
690	
691	        do {
692	            let detailSnapshot = try await session.threadDetailResync(
693	                params: ThreadDetailParams(threadId: row.threadID),
694	                timeout: CodexDockConstants.AppServer.defaultRequestTimeout
695	            )
696	            try await replaceEvents(from: detailSnapshot, liveState: .live)
697	            await replayBufferedLiveEvents()
698	            DockLog.threadDetail.notice("thread detail dock row refresh finished thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) events=\(self.events.count, privacy: .public)")
699	        } catch {
700	            liveEventBuffer.discard()
701	            liveState = .stale(message(from: error))
702	            publishLoaded()
703	            DockLog.threadDetail.warning("thread detail dock row refresh failed thread_id=\(DockLog.publicID(self.row.threadID), privacy: .public) error=\(DockLog.errorSummary(error), privacy: .public)")
704	        }
705	
706	        recoveryTask = nil
707	        if case .loaded = state, liveState == .live {
708	            lastCompletedDockRowRefreshMarker = marker
709	        }
710	        startDockRowRefreshIfNeeded()
711	    }

713	    private func markLiveSessionReconnecting(_ message: String) {
714	        guard !isClosing, case .loaded = state else {
715	            return
716	        }
717	        switch liveState {
718	        case .closed:
719	            return
720	        case .connecting, .reconnecting, .live, .stale:
721	            liveState = .reconnecting(message)

1	import Foundation
2	
3	struct ThreadCardRowProjector {
4	    let hosts: [DockHostConfiguration]
5	    let hostIdentityResolver: DockHostIdentityResolver
6	    let localMetadata: [LocalThreadMetadataKey: LocalThreadMetadata]
7	    let now: @Sendable () -> Date
8	
9	    func rows(from cards: [DockThreadCardDTO]) -> [DockRowViewModel] {
10	        cards.filter(\.isAppFacingHumanThreadCard).map { card in
11	            makeRow(card: card)
12	        }
13	    }
14	
15	    func makeRow(card: DockThreadCardDTO) -> DockRowViewModel {
16	        guard let resolvedSourceHostID = nonEmpty(card.sourceHostID),
17	              let projectionID = nonEmpty(card.projectionID),
18	              let displayOrderKey = nonEmpty(card.displayOrderKey) else {
19	            preconditionFailure("ThreadCardRowProjector only accepts relay projection rows with sourceHostID, projectionID, and displayOrderKey")
20	        }
21	        // Dock rows are projection rows. `logicalHostID` is display payload only;
22	        // action identity follows the relay-owned source host namespace.
23	        let id = HostScopedThreadID(hostID: resolvedSourceHostID, threadID: card.threadID)
24	        let metadata = metadata(
25	            for: id,
26	            backendSessionID: card.backendSessionID,
27	            sourceHostID: resolvedSourceHostID
28	        )
29	        let activityDate = activityDate(for: card)
30	        return DockRowViewModel(
31	            threadIdentity: id,
32	            sourceHostID: resolvedSourceHostID,
33	            projectionID: projectionID,
34	            backendSessionID: card.backendSessionID,
35	            title: nonEmpty(card.title) ?? "Thread \(shortThreadID(card.threadID))",
36	            hostDisplayName: nonEmpty(card.hostDisplayName)
37	                ?? hostDisplayName(for: card.logicalHostID, sourceHostID: resolvedSourceHostID),
38	            hostEndpoint: nonEmpty(card.hostEndpoint)
39	                ?? hostEndpoint(for: card.logicalHostID, sourceHostID: resolvedSourceHostID),
40	            repository: nonEmpty(card.repository) ?? nonEmpty(card.workingDirectory) ?? "Unknown workspace",
41	            branch: nonEmpty(card.branch) ?? "No branch",
42	            status: status(for: card.status),
43	            lastActivity: relativeTime(since: activityDate),
44	            lastActivityDate: activityDate,
45	            displayOrderKey: displayOrderKey,
46	            summary: nonEmpty(card.displaySummary) ?? "No summary",
47	            rail: metadata?.rail ?? rail(for: card),
48	            label: metadata?.label,
49	            origin: origin(for: card),
50	            relationship: relationship(for: card),
51	            isPinned: metadata?.isPinned ?? false,
52	            pinnedAt: metadata?.pinnedAt,
53	            pinnedOrder: metadata?.pinnedOrder
54	        )
55	    }
56	
57	    private func metadata(
58	        for id: HostScopedThreadID,
59	        backendSessionID: String,
60	        sourceHostID: String?
61	    ) -> LocalThreadMetadata? {
62	        let exactKey = LocalThreadMetadataKey(
63	            hostID: id.hostID,
64	            backendSessionID: backendSessionID,
65	            threadID: id.threadID
66	        )
67	        if let metadata = localMetadata[exactKey] {
68	            return metadata
69	        }
70	
71	        return localMetadata.first { key, _ in
72	            guard key.backendSessionID == backendSessionID,
73	                  key.threadID == id.threadID else {
74	                return false
75	            }
76	            return hostIdentityResolver.logicalHostID(
77	                forAlias: key.hostID,
78	                sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceHostID
79	            ) == id.hostID
80	        }?.value
81	    }
82	
83	    private func activityDate(for card: DockThreadCardDTO) -> Date {
84	        // The relay owns card recency. If this timestamp is missing, decoding
85	        // fails at the DTO boundary instead of letting Swift invent an order.
86	        Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(card.activityAtMs) / 1_000)
87	    }
88	
89	    private func status(for status: DockThreadCardStatus) -> DockRowStatusKind {
90	        switch status {
91	        case .running:
92	            return .running
93	        case .needsInput:
94	            return .needsInput
95	        case .needsApproval:
96	            return .needsApproval
97	        case .idle:
98	            return .idle
99	        case .error:
100	            return .error
101	        case .dormant:
102	            return .dormant
103	        case .unknown:
104	            return .unknown
105	        }
106	    }
107	
108	    private func origin(for card: DockThreadCardDTO) -> SessionOrigin {
109	        switch card.lane {
110	        case .human:
111	            return .humanInteractive(subtype: .cli)
112	        case .agent:
113	            return .agentOrAutomation(subtype: .exec)
114	        case .unknown:
115	            switch card.sourceKind {
116	            case .human:
117	                return .humanInteractive(subtype: .cli)
118	            case .automation:
119	                return .agentOrAutomation(subtype: .exec)
120	            case .unknown:
121	                return .unknown()
122	            }
123	        }
124	    }
125	
126	    private func relativeTime(since date: Date) -> String {
127	        guard date != .distantPast else {
128	            return "No activity"
129	        }
130	        let seconds = max(0, Int(now().timeIntervalSince(date)))
131	
132	        switch seconds {
133	        case 0..<60:
134	            return "now"
135	        case 60..<3_600:
136	            return "\(seconds / 60)m ago"
137	        case 3_600..<86_400:
138	            return "\(seconds / 3_600)h ago"
139	        default:
140	            return "\(seconds / 86_400)d ago"
141	        }
142	    }
143	
144	    private func relationship(for card: DockThreadCardDTO) -> DockRowThreadRelationship {
145	        switch card.relationship {
146	        case .forked:
147	            return .forked
148	        case .root, .spawned:
149	            return .root
150	        case .unknown, nil:
151	            return .root
152	        }
153	    }
154	
155	    private func rail(for card: DockThreadCardDTO) -> DockRowRail {
156	        let rails = DockRowRail.allCases
157	        let checksum = card.threadID.utf8.reduce(UInt64(0)) { partial, byte in
158	            (partial &* 31) &+ UInt64(byte)
159	        }
160	        return rails[Int(checksum % UInt64(rails.count))]
161	    }
162	
163	    private func nonEmpty(_ value: String?) -> String? {
164	        let trimmed = value?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
165	        if let trimmed, !trimmed.isEmpty {
166	            return trimmed
167	        }
168	        return nil
169	    }
170	
171	    private func hostDisplayName(for hostID: String, sourceHostID: String? = nil) -> String {
172	        hostIdentityResolver.displayName(forAlias: hostID, sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceHostID)
173	            ?? hostID
174	    }
175	
176	    private func hostEndpoint(for hostID: String, sourceHostID: String? = nil) -> String {
177	        hostIdentityResolver.endpoint(forAlias: hostID, sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceHostID)
178	            ?? hostID
179	    }
180	
181	    private func shortThreadID(_ threadID: String) -> String {
182	        if threadID.count <= 12 {
183	            return threadID
184	        }
185	        return String(threadID.prefix(8))
186	    }
187	}

3	public struct SystemHealthProjector: Sendable {

6	    public func snapshot(
7	        hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot],
8	        overallStatus: AppConnectivityOverallStatus
9	    ) -> SystemHealthSnapshot {
10	        SystemHealthSnapshot(
11	            summary: overallStatus,
12	            categories: SystemHealthCategory.allCases.map { category in
13	                SystemHealthCategorySnapshot(
14	                    category: category,
15	                    status: status(for: category, hosts: hosts, overallStatus: overallStatus)
16	                )
17	            },
18	            hosts: hosts

22	    private func status(
23	        for category: SystemHealthCategory,
24	        hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot],
25	        overallStatus: AppConnectivityOverallStatus
26	    ) -> SystemHealthCategoryStatus {
27	        if hosts.isEmpty {
28	            return .notChecked("No relay host is configured.")
29	        }
30	
31	        let routeNames = routeNames(for: category)
32	        let diagnostics = hosts.flatMap(\.routeDiagnostics).filter { routeNames.contains($0.route) }
33	        if diagnostics.isEmpty {
34	            return fallbackStatus(for: category, overallStatus: overallStatus)
35	        }
36	
37	        if let failed = diagnostics.first(where: { diagnostic in
38	            diagnostic.routeStatus == .failed || diagnostic.routeStatus == .blocked
39	        }) {
40	            return .failed(
41	                failed.statusReasons.first?.message ?? "\(category.title) is failing.",
42	                nextAction: "Run check or open host details."
43	            )
44	        }
45	
46	        if let degraded = diagnostics.first(where: { diagnostic in
47	            diagnostic.routeStatus == .degraded || diagnostic.routeStatus == .partial || diagnostic.routeStatus == .stale
48	        }) {
49	            return .degraded(
50	                degraded.statusReasons.first?.message ?? "\(category.title) has partial or stale evidence.",
51	                nextAction: "Run check or review technical details."
52	            )
53	        }
54	
55	        if diagnostics.contains(where: { $0.routeStatus == .healthy }) {
56	            return .healthy("\(category.title) route evidence is healthy.")
57	        }
58	
59	        return .notChecked("No completed check for \(category.title.lowercased()).")
60	    }

62	    private func fallbackStatus(
63	        for category: SystemHealthCategory,
64	        overallStatus: AppConnectivityOverallStatus
65	    ) -> SystemHealthCategoryStatus {
66	        switch overallStatus {
67	        case .checking, .reconnecting, .resuming:
68	            return .checking("Checking relay health.")
69	        case .online:
70	            switch category {
71	            case .dockFeed:
72	                return .healthy("Dock feed is receiving app evidence.")
73	            case .diagnostics:
74	                return .healthy("Relay process is reachable.")
75	            case .threadDetail, .archive, .voice:

77	            }

81	            return .failed(message, nextAction: "Open Relay Settings.")
82	        case .backgrounded(let message):

148	public final class AppConnectivityStore: ObservableObject, AppConnectivityReporting {
149	    @Published public private(set) var hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot] = []
150	    @Published public private(set) var overallStatus: AppConnectivityOverallStatus
151	
152	    private enum ObservationSource: Hashable {
153	        case dock
154	        case archive
155	        case hostTest
156	        case threadDetail
157	    }

159	    private struct Observation {
160	        var phase: HostConnectivityPhase
161	        var lastCheckedAt: Date?
162	        var lastSuccessAt: Date?
163	    }

166	        var id: String
167	        var displayName: String
168	        var endpoint: String
169	        var observations: [ObservationSource: Observation]

172	    }

174	    private let now: @Sendable () -> Date

176	    private var hostOrder: [String] = []
177	    private var records: [String: HostRecord] = [:]

179	    private var lastLoggedOverallStatus: AppConnectivityOverallStatus?
180	    private var lastLoggedHostPhases: [String: HostConnectivityPhase] = [:]
181	
182	    public init(
183	        registry: HostRegistry? = nil,
184	        configurationError: Error? = nil,
185	        now: @escaping @Sendable () -> Date = Date.init
186	    ) {
187	        self.now = now
188	        if let configurationError {
189	            self.overallStatus = .configurationError(configurationError.localizedDescription)
190	        } else {
191	            self.overallStatus = .unconfigured("No relay host configured.")
192	        }
193	        if let registry {

261	        case .discovering(_, let message):

283	            for host in hosts {

406	    public func reportLifecycle(_ snapshot: AppLifecycleSnapshot) {
407	        switch snapshot.phase {
408	        case .backgrounded:
409	            markAllHosts(.backgrounded("Backgrounded"))
410	        case .foregroundResuming:
411	            markAllHosts(.resuming("Resuming"))
412	        case .active:
413	            clearLifecyclePhase()
414	        case .inactive:
415	            return
416	        }

418	
419	    private func record(hostStates: [DockHostStateViewModel], source: ObservationSource) {
420	        for hostState in hostStates {
421	            let phase: HostConnectivityPhase
422	            switch hostState.status {
423	            case .checking:
424	                phase = .checking
425	            case .loaded(let rowCount, _):
426	                phase = .online("\(rowCount) sessions")
427	            case .degraded(_, let message):
428	                phase = .partial(message)
429	            case .empty:
430	                phase = .online("Online, no sessions")
431	            case .offline(let message):
432	                phase = .offline(message)
433	            case .error(let message):
434	                phase = .error(message)
435	            }
436	            record(host: hostState.host, source: source, phase: phase)
437	        }
438	    }
439	
440	    private func markAllHosts(_ phase: HostConnectivityPhase) {
441	        guard !records.isEmpty else {
442	            overallStatus = rollup([])
443	            return
444	        }
445	        for id in Array(records.keys) {
446	            records[id]?.lifecyclePhase = phase
447	        }
448	        publish()
449	    }
450	
451	    private func clearLifecyclePhase() {
452	        guard !records.isEmpty else {
453	            publishBootstrapStatusIfNeeded()
454	            return
455	        }
456	        for id in Array(records.keys) {
457	            records[id]?.lifecyclePhase = nil
458	        }
459	        publish()
460	    }
461	
462	    private func record(
463	        host: DockHostViewModel,
464	        source: ObservationSource,
465	        phase: HostConnectivityPhase,
466	        checked: Bool = true,
467	        checkedAt: Date? = nil,
468	        successAt: Date? = nil
469	    ) {
470	        bootstrapStatus = nil
471	        let timestamp = checkedAt ?? (checked ? now() : nil)
472	        var record = records[host.id] ?? HostRecord(
473	            id: host.id,
474	            displayName: host.displayName,
475	            endpoint: host.endpoint,
476	            observations: [:],
477	            routeDiagnostics: [:],
478	            lifecyclePhase: nil
479	        )
480	        if !hostOrder.contains(host.id) {
481	            hostOrder.append(host.id)
482	        }
483	        let existingObservation = record.observations[source]
484	        let lastSuccessAt: Date?
485	        if let successAt {
486	            lastSuccessAt = successAt
487	        } else if phase.isOnlineLike {
488	            lastSuccessAt = timestamp ?? now()
489	        } else {
490	            lastSuccessAt = existingObservation?.lastSuccessAt
491	        }
492	
493	        record.observations[source] = Observation(
494	            phase: phase,
495	            lastCheckedAt: timestamp ?? existingObservation?.lastCheckedAt,
496	            lastSuccessAt: lastSuccessAt
497	        )
498	        records[host.id] = record
499	        publish()
500	    }
501	
502	    private func publishBootstrapStatusIfNeeded() {
503	        guard records.isEmpty else {
504	            publish()
505	            return
506	        }
507	        hosts = []
508	        overallStatus = bootstrapStatus ?? .unconfigured("No relay host configured.")
509	        logOverallStatusIfNeeded(overallStatus)
510	    }
511	
512	    private func publish() {
513	        let nextHosts = records.values
514	            .map(snapshot(from:))
515	            .sorted { lhs, rhs in
516	                let leftIndex = hostIndex(lhs.id)
517	                let rightIndex = hostIndex(rhs.id)
518	                if leftIndex == rightIndex {
519	                    return lhs.displayName < rhs.displayName
520	                }
521	                return leftIndex < rightIndex
522	            }
523	        let nextOverallStatus = rollup(nextHosts)
524	        hosts = nextHosts
525	        overallStatus = nextOverallStatus
526	        logHostPhasesIfNeeded(nextHosts)
527	        logOverallStatusIfNeeded(nextOverallStatus)
528	    }
529	
530	    private func snapshot(from record: HostRecord) -> HostConnectivitySnapshot {
531	        let observations = Array(record.observations.values)
532	        let routeDiagnostics = record.routeDiagnostics.values.sorted { $0.route < $1.route }
533	        let routePhase = phaseForRouteDiagnostics(routeDiagnostics)
534	        let observationPhase = rollupObservations(observations)
535	        return HostConnectivitySnapshot(
536	            id: record.id,
537	            displayName: record.displayName,
538	            endpoint: record.endpoint,
539	            phase: record.lifecyclePhase ?? routePhase ?? observationPhase,
540	            lastCheckedAt: latestDate(observations.compactMap(\.lastCheckedAt)),
541	            lastSuccessAt: latestDate(observations.compactMap(\.lastSuccessAt)),
542	            routeDiagnostics: routeDiagnostics
543	        )
544	    }
545	
546	    private func phaseForRouteDiagnostics(_ diagnostics: [RouteDiagnosticSnapshot]) -> HostConnectivityPhase? {
547	        guard let failed = diagnostics.first(where: { $0.appCritical && $0.routeStatus == .failed }) else {
548	            return nil
549	        }
550	        return .partial("\(failed.route) failed")
551	    }
552	
553	    private func rollupObservations(_ observations: [Observation]) -> HostConnectivityPhase {
554	        guard let strongest = observations.min(by: {
555	            priority(for: $0.phase) < priority(for: $1.phase)
556	        }) else {
557	            return .unknown
558	        }
559	        return strongest.phase
560	    }
561	
562	    private func rollup(_ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot]) -> AppConnectivityOverallStatus {
563	        guard !hosts.isEmpty else {
564	            return bootstrapStatus ?? .unconfigured("No relay host configured.")
565	        }
566	
567	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
568	            if case .configurationError = $0.phase { return true }
569	            return false
570	        }) {
571	            return .configurationError(status.phase.message)
572	        }
573	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
574	            if case .backgrounded = $0.phase { return true }
575	            return false
576	        }) {
577	            return .backgrounded("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
578	        }
579	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
580	            if case .resuming = $0.phase { return true }
581	            return false
582	        }) {
583	            return .resuming("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
584	        }
585	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
586	            if case .reconnecting = $0.phase { return true }
587	            return false
588	        }) {
589	            return .reconnecting("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
590	        }
591	        if let status = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
592	            if case .stale = $0.phase { return true }
593	            return false
594	        }) {
595	            return .stale("\(status.displayName): \(status.phase.message)")
596	        }
597	        let onlineLikeCount = hosts.filter { $0.phase.isOnlineLike }.count
598	        let checkingCount = hosts.filter { status in
599	            if case .checking = status.phase {
600	                return true
601	            }
602	            return false
603	        }.count
604	        if checkingCount == hosts.count {
605	            return .checking(hosts.count == 1 ? hosts[0].phase.message : "Checking \(hosts.count) hosts")
606	        }
607	        if onlineLikeCount > 0, checkingCount > 0 {
608	            return .partial("Online \(onlineLikeCount)/\(hosts.count), checking \(checkingCount)")
609	        }
610	        if onlineLikeCount == hosts.count {
611	            if let partial = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
612	                if case .partial = $0.phase { return true }
613	                return false
614	            }) {
615	                return .partial("\(partial.displayName): \(partial.phase.message)")
616	            }
617	            return .online(hosts.count == 1 ? hosts[0].phase.message : "\(hosts.count) hosts online")
618	        }
619	        if onlineLikeCount > 0 {
620	            let failing = hosts.first { !$0.phase.isOnlineLike } ?? hosts[0]
621	            return .partial("\(failing.displayName): \(failing.phase.message)")
622	        }
623	
624	        if let error = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
625	            if case .error = $0.phase { return true }
626	            return false
627	        }) {
628	            return .error("\(error.displayName): \(error.phase.message)")
629	        }
630	        if let offline = firstStatus(hosts, matching: {
631	            if case .offline = $0.phase { return true }
632	            return false
633	        }) {
634	            return .offline("\(offline.displayName): \(offline.phase.message)")
635	        }
636	
637	        return .checking("Waiting for first check")
638	    }
639	
640	    private func priority(for phase: HostConnectivityPhase) -> Int {
641	        switch phase {
642	        case .configurationError:
643	            return 0
644	        case .backgrounded:
645	            return 1
646	        case .resuming:
647	            return 2
648	        case .reconnecting:
649	            return 3
650	        case .stale:
651	            return 4
652	        case .checking:
653	            return 5
654	        case .offline:
655	            return 6
656	        case .error:
657	            return 7
658	        case .partial:
659	            return 8
660	        case .online:
661	            return 9
662	        case .unknown:
663	            return 10
664	        }
665	    }
666	
667	    private func firstStatus(
668	        _ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot],
669	        matching predicate: (HostConnectivitySnapshot) -> Bool
670	    ) -> HostConnectivitySnapshot? {
671	        hosts.first(where: predicate)
672	    }
673	
674	    private func latestDate(_ dates: [Date]) -> Date? {
675	        dates.max()
676	    }
677	
678	    private func hostIndex(_ hostID: String) -> Int {
679	        hostOrder.firstIndex(of: hostID) ?? Int.max
680	    }
681	
682	    private func logHostPhasesIfNeeded(_ hosts: [HostConnectivitySnapshot]) {
683	        for host in hosts {
684	            guard lastLoggedHostPhases[host.id] != host.phase else {
685	                continue
686	            }
687	            lastLoggedHostPhases[host.id] = host.phase
688	            DockLog.connectivity.info("connectivity host phase host_id=\(host.id, privacy: .public) endpoint=\(host.endpoint, privacy: .public) phase=\(host.phase.logDescription, privacy: .public) message=\(DockLog.redacted(host.phase.message), privacy: .public)")
689	        }
690	    }
691	
692	    private func logOverallStatusIfNeeded(_ status: AppConnectivityOverallStatus) {
693	        guard lastLoggedOverallStatus != status else {
694	            return
695	        }
696	        lastLoggedOverallStatus = status
697	        DockLog.connectivity.notice("connectivity overall status=\(status.label, privacy: .public) message=\(DockLog.redacted(status.message), privacy: .public)")
698	    }
699	}
700	
701	private extension HostConnectivityPhase {
702	    var logDescription: String {
703	        switch self {
704	        case .unknown:
705	            return "unknown"
706	        case .checking:
707	            return "checking"
708	        case .online:
709	            return "online"
710	        case .partial:
711	            return "partial"
712	        case .reconnecting:
713	            return "reconnecting"
714	        case .backgrounded:
715	            return "backgrounded"
716	        case .resuming:
717	            return "resuming"
718	        case .stale:
719	            return "stale"
720	        case .offline:
721	            return "offline"
722	        case .error:
723	            return "error"
724	        case .configurationError:
725	            return "configurationError"
726	        }
727	    }
728	}
